_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'sunken_wolds' (The Sunken Wolds). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

lowmoor_elder.name: Elder Coombe
lowmoor_elder.greeting: The wolds sank, the village didn't. Yet.

bastion_keeper.name: Keeper Isolde
bastion_keeper.greeting: The bastion's covered in moss. So is the keeper, some mornings.

deepdene_digger.name: Digger Wat
deepdene_digger.greeting: There's caves under everything here. And things in the caves. And under the things, more caves.

quests.name: Stalkers in the Moss
quests.offer: Frost stalkers den in the mossy hollows. They take the sheep first and the shepherds second.
quests.done: Sheep safe. Shepherds safe. Moss unbothered.

quests.name: Mushroom Men
quests.offer: The sporecap walkers are walking into the village. They're slow, but they're persistent.
quests.done: Lowmoor smells of mushroom less. Thank you.

quests.name: The Lurker Below
quests.offer: Something in the sinkholes grabs ankles. Silt lurkers. I'm fond of my ankles.

quests.name: That's Not a Chest
quests.offer: Diggers found a chest in a cave. The chest found them back. Hoard mimics. Kill them and bring me whatever they swallowed.
quests.done: Gold! And a boot! And a digger I lost last year — no, wait, that's just the boot.

quests.name: The Wold Caves
quests.offer: The river runs into the wold caves and comes out warmer. Something down there is very large and very warm.

steps.text: Defeat what lives at the bottom

quests.done: The river runs cold again. And so do my nerves, finally.

quests.name: The Wolds' Old Hunter
quests.offer: There's one thing in the wolds that even the stalkers fear. It's my turn to be brave by sending you.
quests.done: Brave of me. And of you, a bit.
